sentences.en: She herself is a member of the SVP Conference, which runs a canteen for 200 children every day.

sentences.en: St Mary's SVP are arranging a Summer Outing with a tea for the senior parishioners.

sentences.en: Pipework connecting discharge appliances to SVP manifold, should be designed not to cause self siphonage.

sentences.en: Systematic depth bias at swath edges due to SVP errors is visible superimposed on far range noise.
